sectionsBeforeTable.title: What We Check on Every Lot
paragraphs: Premium vermicompost is not just about NPK numbers on a label. We monitor feedstock quality, composting and curing time, screening, moisture before packing, and enrichment with beneficial microbes and botanical extracts.
Agricultural and organic marketing claims must follow applicable Indian rules. We share documentation we have; certification status is discussed transparently on enquiry.

faqs.question: Can I get lab documentation before a bulk order?
faqs.answer: Yes. Contact us with your district and quantity. We share available quality documentation for current batches where applicable.

faqs.question: How should I store 50 kg bags?
faqs.answer: Store in shade on a dry pallet. Avoid puncturing bags and keep opened stock covered to maintain moisture balance.

faqs.question: Is Satva certified organic?
faqs.answer: Ask us directly about current certification status and which claims we can support on labels and marketing. Do not assume certification without written confirmation.
